description: Machine-readable map of every benchmark / retrieval / moat gate to exactly one CI lane. The lane_audit.py gate asserts (a) each target is a real make target, (b) no gate is in two lanes, and (c) the benchmark-validation lane agrees bidirectionally with the .github/workflows/nightly.yml job (no gate run-but-unmapped, none mapped-but-unrun).
